title: Control Environment
text: The entity demonstrates a commitment to integrity and ethical values, exercises oversight responsibility, establishes structure and authority, demonstrates commitment to competence, and enforces accountability for internal control objectives. Mindset and operations create a culture of honesty and ethical behavior, supported by leadership, board oversight, and evaluation of personnel against standards of conduct.

title: Communication and Information
text: The entity obtains or generates and uses relevant, quality information to support the functioning of internal control and communicates internally and externally, including to external parties, matters affecting the functioning of other components of internal control.

title: Risk Assessment
text: The entity specifies objectives, identifies and analyzes risks to the achievement of objectives (including fraud and changes), and considers the potential for fraud in assessing risks to the achievement of objectives.

title: Monitoring Activities
text: The entity selects, develops, and performs ongoing and/or separate evaluations of its control activities to ascertain whether components of internal control are present and functioning, and communicates deficiencies to responsible parties.

title: Control Activities
text: The entity selects and develops control activities that contribute to the mitigation of risks to the achievement of objectives, including general and application controls over technology, and selects and develops control activities over technology infrastructure, software, processes, and security management.

title: Logical and Physical Access
text: The entity restricts logical and physical access, provides them only to authorized personnel, prevents and detects unauthorized access to system resources, and removes access when removed from the organization. Includes access provisioning, authentication, authorization (privileged, need-to-know), protection against malicious code, and disposal of system assets with control over media.

title: System Operations
text: The entity maintains and monitors the operation of the system to detect variances from system specifications that could result in a failure to meet the criteria, and prevents or detects and responds to security incidents, including backup restoration, software change management, monitoring of system components, and identification of and response to incidents.

title: Change Management
text: The entity manages system changes, including configuration changes, changes to application/system software, and changes to data files, to meet the objectives of the service organization's business and the system, including identification, approval, testing, and tracking of system changes.

title: Risk Mitigation
text: The entity identifies, selects, and develops risk mitigation activities for risks arising from potential business disruptions and the use of vendors and other business partners (third-party and vendor management).

title: Availability
text: The system is available for operation and use as committed or agreed. Addresses the availability of the system for processing and typical workloads, including capacity planning, environmental protections, monitoring, and contingency planning for system resilience.

title: Confidentiality
text: Information designated as confidential is protected to meet the entity's objectives. Addresses protection of confidential information at all points in its life cycle, including through storage, processing, and transmission, from access, use, or disclosure by unauthorized parties.

title: Privacy
text: Personal information is collected, used, retained, disclosed, and disposed of to meet the entity's objectives. Addresses notice, choice and consent, collection, use and retention, access and disclosure, and quality of personal information.

title: Processing Integrity
text: System processing is complete, valid, accurate, timely, and authorized to meet the entity's objectives, addressing completeness and accuracy of data processing, error handling, and authorization of processing.
